lines.meet: I'm Saoirse, and I stand in front of things for a living now. Get behind me, keep your head up, and if you get notions this ball's coming at you.
lines.meet_neighbour: The Sepulcher, is it? We're near enough neighbours, so, and I've clocked you about the place. Saoirse, and I'm the loud one.
lines.ask_home: Go on, which county are you from? Or country, I suppose, out here.
lines.ask_work: Were you any good at your job, back home? Tell me what it was first.
lines.answer_home: Kilkenny, home of hurling, whatever Cork says. My da farmed and my mam was a nurse, and I had a hurl in my hand at five.
lines.answer_work: Camogie for the county till my knee went at twenty-six, then coaching under-sixteen girls. I loved the coaching more, if you can believe that.
lines.chat_food: A spice bag from the chipper after training, eaten in the car with the heater on. Don't knock it till you've tried it.
lines.chat_sleep: Out the minute my head's down, every night, snoring like a tractor, they tell me. Training does that.
lines.chat_missing: The Nowlan Park crowd on a county final day, with the whole town out. You've never heard noise like it.
lines.chat_here: I landed somewhere that wanted a body stood in front, and that's the one thing I was ever any good at. It's been easy for me here, and I'm a bit ashamed of how easy.
lines.tease_quiet: Would it kill you to shout once in a while, {name}? I'd have you roaring on the sideline inside a week.
lines.tease_talker: You'd talk a referee out of a red card, {name}, and then talk yourself back into one.
lines.tease_careful: You'd stop to tie your laces in the middle of a match, {name}. Run, for God's sake, run!
lines.tease_bold: You'd go for a ball with three of them on you, {name}, and I'd pick you first for it.
lines.tease_any: If you were on my team, {name}, I'd have you running laps till you were sick, and you'd thank me.
lines.tease_back: Ha, that's a cracker, {name}! I'll have to watch you.
lines.take_it_kindly: Grand, {name}, guilty as charged. I'll not argue.
lines.bristle: Mind yourself now, {name}, that one's a step too far.
lines.apologise: Ah, I went in too hard there, and I'm sorry. I do that, I'm working on it.
lines.double_down: Every bit of that was meant, so. Better from me than from somebody who doesn't care.
lines.needle_quiet: Open your mouth and shout when you see something! A silent team's a beaten team.
lines.needle_talker: Less chat, more running, please. You'd talk the legs off a chair.
lines.needle_careful: You're thinking about it while it's hitting you. Move first and think on the way!
lines.needle_bold: You're playing for yourself out there, not the team. I've dropped girls for less.
lines.needle_any: You're getting above yourself, and you know what happens to people who do that. This ball doesn't miss.
lines.bite_back: I've taken every hit that came at this party for months, so watch what you say about my effort.
lines.hurt: Right, that one hit. I'll go and run it off.
lines.laugh_off: My under-sixteens gave me worse every Tuesday, and they were funnier. Try harder, so.
lines.confide: {name}, my parents went within a year of each other when I was twenty-nine, and I didn't fall apart, and I've felt guilty about that for years.
lines.listen: Sit down there, {name}, and tell me all of it. I'm not going anywhere.
lines.look_out: Keep in my shadow, {name}, and stay there, that's what I'm for.
lines.deflect: Ah, I'm grand, {name}, it's only a knock. I've had worse in a club match.
lines.check_in: Up you come, {name}, slowly. Where'd it get you?
lines.blame: Somebody broke the line in there, and I couldn't cover the gap.
lines.thank: Fair play, you got me up off the ground. Thanks a million.
lines.brush_off: Not a bother, that's what a team's for. Get your breath back.
lines.worry: God almighty, {name}, stay down a minute. You frightened the life out of me.
lines.handed_down: Right, so I'm in your gear now. I'll mind it like my own hurl.
lines.hand_fine: Sure take it, it fits you better. I've my ball and my stick and that'll do me.
lines.hand_sulk: A bit of warning would've been nice, that's all.
lines.turn_friendly: You'd make my team, {name}, and I'd put you in the starting fifteen.
lines.turn_friends: Captain's armband's yours if I ever get hurt, {name}. That's me trusting you completely.
lines.turn_grating: Look, we're not gelling, and there's no use pretending we are.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll still take the hits for you, because I take them for everybody. Don't read anything into it.
lines.make_up: Ah, would you stop, {name}, this is daft. Shake my hand and we'll start again.
lines.defend: Back off now, that's out of order. {name} did nothing to deserve that.
lines.friend_left: With {name} off home, there's nobody to throw the ball at. I've been aiming at trees.
lines.friend_back: Look who's back, it's {name}! I've been aiming at trees for weeks.
lines.common_sport: Anybody who's played proper sport knows the knee goes, or the back goes, and then you coach. And then you find out you love the coaching more.
lines.common_irish: An Irish accent out here, that's put a grin on me. Which county, and please don't say Tipperary.
lines.common_teacher: There's a look you get from yard duty in the rain, and you have it. You've taught, haven't you?
